nodes.title: Material library (read me first)
widgets_values:
A set of 14 tileable PBR materials (1024², seamless on all four sides, **one image = 1 m × 1 m**, 1024 px/m; the modular building kit's UVs are also 1 UV = 1 m, so bricks and planks come out real size), 5 maps each:
  BaseColor (sRGB) / Normal_GL (+Y) / Normal_DX (−Y, DirectX convention) / ORM (R = AO, G = roughness, B = metallic) / Height (16-bit, range in the .json)
Written to output/pcg/materials/, file names T_material_map.png.

  M_Wall         240 × 67 mm bricks, 10 mm joints struck 7 mm back, chipped arrises, per-brick colour (reds, clinker, buff), fire flash, iron specks, salt bloom
  Ground_Cobble  ~12 cm domed field stones in sand, four stone types (granite, sandstone, basalt, pink granite) with grain, soil round the feet, moss in the joints
  M_Door         vertical 12.5 cm planks, V joints, staggered butt joints, growth rings deflected by knots, nails with rust runs
  M_Roof         25 mm seams every 50 cm, stiffening ribs, oil canning; paint chipping to galvanized steel (metallic), fall-line dirt, rust
  M_Trim         smooth painted precast / stucco with pores and rain-washed grime -- reads right on bands, sills and cornices
  M_Glass        dark tinted, roughness 0.04 when clean; dirt film, drips and smudges raise the roughness
  M_Metal        dark coat, scratches in six directions to bare steel (metallic), burnished scuffs, rust pinholes
  M_Sign         mustard enamel with brush marks, sun fading, craquelure in patches, flakes down to grey primer
  M_BrickBuff    the same bricks in yellow-grey stock clay with purple and orange strays, soot patches
  M_Stucco       cream lime render: trowel undulation, hairline cracks, old coats showing, spalled patches down to the base, rain streaks
  Ground_Asphalt dark asphalt with exposed aggregate, sun bleaching, oil drips, tar-sealed cracks
  M_RoofFlat     flat-roof bitumen membrane with mineral grit, ponding stains and patched seams
  M_FacadeFar    a whole 4 m × 3.5 m facade bay (window, frame, sill, floor band) for low-detail context buildings
  M_FacadeFarBrick the same bay in a brick colour

The names are the modular building kit's material slots (M_Wall / M_Trim / M_Glass / M_Door / M_Metal / M_Roof / M_Sign): the kit's glb files already point to these images by relative path, so run this workflow first and the kit opens textured.

**One pair of wrangles per material.** The first writes @height **in metres** (Height to Normal / AO run at Strength 1, World Size 1 m, so a 7 mm joint is 7 mm), plus masks the second one needs; the second writes basecolor / ao / roughness / metallic. Colours are typed as display (sRGB) values and turned linear with ** 2.2 at the end, because Write File encodes BaseColor to sRGB.

**How seamlessness is guaranteed**: all noise is pnoise() with period = frequency (integer cells per metre), Pattern counts are integers, stripes are periodic functions of u / v, and the scratch directions use integer (a, b) so rotated lines wrap too. noise() is not periodic -- don't use it in a tileable texture.

Right of each pair: a studio preview of the material on a 2 m wall slab and a sphere (the slab shows a 2 × 2 repeat, so any seam would show).

# fbm(fx, fy, s, o): seamless fractal noise with fx × fy cells per metre (integers; unequal = stretched), seed s,
# o octaves; normalized to roughly unit variance (about -2.5..2.5), so thresholds read the same at any octave count
def fbm(fx, fy, s, o=4):
    t = 0
    a = 1.0
    n = 0
    for i in range(o):
        t = t + a * (pnoise(set(@u * fx, @v * fy, s + i * 7.13), set(fx, fy, 0)) - 0.5)
        n = n + a * a
        fx = fx * 2
        fy = fy * 2
        a = a * 0.5
    return t / (0.135 * sqrt(n))

# Height in metres (1024 px = 1 m; Height to Normal / AO use Strength 1, World Size 1, so the relief is real size)
e = @pattern_edge / 1024
r2 = rand(@pattern_id + 0.37)
# chipped, irregular arrises: the brick outline is eaten back 0.5-3 mm by coarse noise, more on some bricks
ee = e - clamp(0.0006 + 0.0010 * r2 + 0.0008 * fbm(48, 48, 3.1, 3), 0, 0.004)
@brick = smoothstep(-0.0004, 0.0006, ee)
# brick face: 3 mm rounded arris (quarter circle), a slight random tilt per brick, undulation, sand-struck pits
t = clamp(ee / 0.003, 0, 1)
arris = -0.003 * (1 - sqrt(1 - (1 - t) ** 2))
tilt = 0.0015 * ((@pattern_uv.x - 0.5) * (rand(@pattern_id + 0.11) - 0.5) + (@pattern_uv.y - 0.5) * (rand(@pattern_id + 0.23) - 0.5))
pits = -0.0012 * smoothstep(2.0, 2.6, fbm(192, 192, 5.5, 2))
face = arris + tilt + 0.0005 * fbm(8, 8, 1.7, 4) + 0.00012 * fbm(256, 256, 2.9, 2) + pits
@pits = smoothstep(2.0, 2.6, fbm(192, 192, 5.5, 2))
# joint: struck 7 mm back from the face, sandy
mortar = -0.007 + 0.0003 * fbm(160, 160, 9.1, 3)
@height = lerp(mortar, face, @brick)
nodes.title: M_Wall: height (metres) + masks

# fbm(fx, fy, s, o): seamless fractal noise with fx × fy cells per metre (integers; unequal = stretched), seed s,
# o octaves; normalized to roughly unit variance (about -2.5..2.5), so thresholds read the same at any octave count
def fbm(fx, fy, s, o=4):
    t = 0
    a = 1.0
    n = 0
    for i in range(o):
        t = t + a * (pnoise(set(@u * fx, @v * fy, s + i * 7.13), set(fx, fy, 0)) - 0.5)
        n = n + a * a
        fx = fx * 2
        fy = fy * 2
        a = a * 0.5
    return t / (0.135 * sqrt(n))

r = @pattern_rand
r2 = rand(@pattern_id + 0.37)
r3 = rand(@pattern_id + 0.71)
# brick bodies: a spread of reds and oranges, ~12 % dark over-fired (clinker), a few pale buff ones
body = lerp(set(0.50, 0.22, 0.14), set(0.68, 0.36, 0.22), r)
body = where(r2 > 0.88, lerp(set(0.30, 0.15, 0.11), set(0.40, 0.21, 0.15), r3), body)
body = where(r2 < 0.05, set(0.70, 0.52, 0.36), body)
# inside each brick: mottling, a darker fire flash towards one end, dark iron specks
m = fbm(16, 16, 2.3, 4)
body = body * (1 + 0.07 * m)
end = where(r3 > 0.5, @pattern_uv.x, 1 - @pattern_uv.x)
body = body * (1 - 0.30 * smoothstep(0.55, 1.0, end) * smoothstep(0.4, 0.9, r))
body = lerp(body, set(0.16, 0.09, 0.07), 0.7 * smoothstep(2.1, 2.6, fbm(320, 320, 7.7, 2)))
body = lerp(body, body * 0.75, @pits)
# mortar: lime-grey, sand grains
mortar = set(0.60, 0.58, 0.54) * (1 + 0.06 * fbm(96, 96, 8.8, 3))
c = lerp(mortar, body, @brick)
# efflorescence (pale salt bloom) in large soft patches, and grime that collects in the cavities
c = lerp(c, set(0.80, 0.78, 0.74), 0.35 * smoothstep(0.9, 2.0, fbm(3, 3, 4.4, 3)) * smoothstep(0.0, 1.2, fbm(64, 64, 2.2, 3)))
c = c * lerp(0.72, 1.0, @ao_h)
@ao = @ao_h
@roughness = clamp(lerp(0.95, 0.84 + 0.04 * m, @brick) + 0.08 * @pits, 0, 1)
@metallic = 0
# the colours above are picked as display (sRGB) values; the layer is linear -- Write File encodes it to sRGB
@basecolor = clamp(c, 0, 1) ** 2.2

# fbm(fx, fy, s, o): seamless fractal noise with fx × fy cells per metre (integers; unequal = stretched), seed s,
# o octaves; normalized to roughly unit variance (about -2.5..2.5), so thresholds read the same at any octave count
def fbm(fx, fy, s, o=4):
    t = 0
    a = 1.0
    n = 0
    for i in range(o):
        t = t + a * (pnoise(set(@u * fx, @v * fy, s + i * 7.13), set(fx, fy, 0)) - 0.5)
        n = n + a * a
        fx = fx * 2
        fy = fy * 2
        a = a * 0.5
    return t / (0.135 * sqrt(n))

e = @pattern_edge / 1024
r2 = rand(@pattern_id + 0.5)
# joint: 8 mm either side of the cell edge, wobbly; stone foot sits 2 cm down in the bedding sand
jw = 0.008 + 0.0018 * fbm(24, 24, 1.3, 3)
@stone = smoothstep(0.0, 0.0015, e - jw)
t = clamp((e - jw) / 0.008, 0, 1)
@shoulder = t
# the stone's form is a dome from the distance to the cell centre (round, smooth everywhere); the distance to the
# joint only gives a narrow 8 mm rounded lip -- a wide ramp on it would show the Voronoi corners as pyramid facets
shoulder = sqrt(1 - (1 - t) ** 2)
dome = 1 - clamp(@pattern_dist / 0.75, 0, 1.2) ** 2
top = 0.008 + 0.026 * clamp(dome, -0.3, 1) + 0.006 * (r2 - 0.5)
stone = -0.02 + shoulder * (top + 0.0012 * fbm(24, 24, 4.2, 3)) + 0.00015 * fbm(256, 256, 6.1, 2) - 0.0008 * smoothstep(1.7, 2.4, fbm(96, 96, 7.3, 2))
joint = -0.02 + 0.0018 * fbm(64, 64, 2.6, 3)
@height = lerp(joint, stone, @stone)

# fbm(fx, fy, s, o): seamless fractal noise with fx × fy cells per metre (integers; unequal = stretched), seed s,
# o octaves; normalized to roughly unit variance (about -2.5..2.5), so thresholds read the same at any octave count
def fbm(fx, fy, s, o=4):
    t = 0
    a = 1.0
    n = 0
    for i in range(o):
        t = t + a * (pnoise(set(@u * fx, @v * fy, s + i * 7.13), set(fx, fy, 0)) - 0.5)
        n = n + a * a
        fx = fx * 2
        fy = fy * 2
        a = a * 0.5
    return t / (0.135 * sqrt(n))

r = @pattern_rand
r2 = rand(@pattern_id + 0.5)
r3 = rand(@pattern_id + 0.9)
# one stone type per cobble: grey granite, warm sandstone, blue-grey basalt, pink granite
c = where(r < 0.4, set(0.55, 0.54, 0.52), where(r < 0.65, set(0.58, 0.52, 0.44), where(r < 0.88, set(0.40, 0.41, 0.42), set(0.58, 0.50, 0.47))))
c = c * (0.82 + 0.3 * r2)
# granite-like grain (light and dark crystals) and mottling
g = fbm(256, 256, 3.7 + r3 * 40, 2)
c = c * (1 + 0.10 * g + 0.06 * fbm(24, 24, 5.9 + r3 * 40, 3))
c = lerp(c, set(0.12, 0.12, 0.12), 0.6 * smoothstep(1.6, 2.2, g))
c = lerp(c, set(0.85, 0.84, 0.80), 0.5 * smoothstep(1.7, 2.3, -g))
# dirt collects round each stone's foot
soil = lerp(set(0.27, 0.23, 0.18), set(0.44, 0.39, 0.32), smoothstep(-1.2, 1.2, fbm(16, 16, 8.2, 3)))
c = lerp(c, soil * 0.9, 0.5 * (1 - smoothstep(0.0, 0.9, @shoulder)) + 0.25 * smoothstep(0.3, 1.0, @pattern_dist / 0.75))
c = lerp(soil, c, @stone)
# moss in the joints (and creeping onto the stone feet) in large patches
mz = smoothstep(0.2, 1.2, fbm(4, 4, 1.9, 3)) * smoothstep(-0.6, 0.8, fbm(80, 80, 2.4, 2))
mz = mz * (1 - smoothstep(0.1, 0.4, @shoulder) * @stone)
c = lerp(c, lerp(set(0.24, 0.30, 0.11), set(0.36, 0.42, 0.17), smoothstep(-1, 1, fbm(60, 60, 4.8, 2))), mz)
c = c * lerp(0.7, 1.0, @ao_h)
@ao = @ao_h
# worn stone tops are smoother than the sides; joints and moss are fully rough
@roughness = clamp(lerp(1.0, 0.72 - 0.18 * @shoulder, @stone) + 0.3 * mz, 0, 1)
@metallic = 0
# the colours above are picked as display (sRGB) values; the layer is linear -- Write File encodes it to sRGB
@basecolor = clamp(c, 0, 1) ** 2.2

widgets_values:
# fbm(fx, fy, s, o): seamless fractal noise with fx × fy cells per metre (integers; unequal = stretched), seed s,
# o octaves; normalized to roughly unit variance (about -2.5..2.5), so thresholds read the same at any octave count
def fbm(fx, fy, s, o=4):
    t = 0
    a = 1.0
    n = 0
    for i in range(o):
        t = t + a * (pnoise(set(@u * fx, @v * fy, s + i * 7.13), set(fx, fy, 0)) - 0.5)
        n = n + a * a
        fx = fx * 2
        fy = fy * 2
        a = a * 0.5
    return t / (0.135 * sqrt(n))

N = 8
x = @u * N
col = floor(x)
pu = x - col
cr = rand(col + 0.13)
pv = frac(@v + rand(col + 0.57))
e = min(min(pu, 1 - pu) / N, min(pv, 1 - pv))
@plank = smoothstep(0.0015, 0.0027, e)
@pu = pu
@cr = cr
# grain: flat-sawn growth rings running along the plank, warped by noise stretched along it; knots deflect it
has = where(rand(col + 0.9) > 0.45, 1.0, 0.0)
du = (pu - 0.25 - 0.5 * rand(col + 0.21)) / N
dv = frac(@v - rand(col + 0.33) + 0.5) - 0.5
dk = sqrt(du * du + (dv * 0.35) ** 2)
@knot = has * (1 - smoothstep(0.007, 0.012, dk))
phase = pu * 3.0 + 0.5 * fbm(32, 2, 3.3 + cr * 50, 4) + cr * 7 + has * 2.5 * exp(-dk / 0.015)
ring = frac(phase * 2.2)
late = smoothstep(0.62, 0.86, ring) * (1 - smoothstep(0.90, 1.0, ring))
@late = late
@pores = smoothstep(0.8, 2.0, fbm(256, 8, 6.6 + cr * 50, 2))
# nails: two battens per metre, one nail per plank on each, 9 mm heads
nv = min(abs(frac(@v) - 0.15), abs(frac(@v) - 0.65))
nu = (pu - 0.5) / N
dn = sqrt(nu * nu + nv * nv)
@dn = dn
@nail = 1 - smoothstep(0.0040, 0.0050, dn)
# relief: weathered grain (soft earlywood worn back), slight cupping, 1.2 mm rounded plank edges, V joints 4 mm deep
t = clamp((e - 0.0015) / 0.0012, 0, 1)
face = -0.0006 * (2 * pu - 1) ** 2 + 0.00035 * late - 0.00015 * @pores + 0.0004 * @knot - 0.0012 * (1 - sqrt(1 - (1 - t) ** 2))
@height = lerp(-0.004, face, @plank) + @nail * 0.0012 * sqrt(clamp(1 - (dn / 0.005) ** 2, 0, 1))
nodes.title: M_Door: height (metres) + masks

widgets_values:
# fbm(fx, fy, s, o): seamless fractal noise with fx × fy cells per metre (integers; unequal = stretched), seed s,
# o octaves; normalized to roughly unit variance (about -2.5..2.5), so thresholds read the same at any octave count
def fbm(fx, fy, s, o=4):
    t = 0
    a = 1.0
    n = 0
    for i in range(o):
        t = t + a * (pnoise(set(@u * fx, @v * fy, s + i * 7.13), set(fx, fy, 0)) - 0.5)
        n = n + a * a
        fx = fx * 2
        fy = fy * 2
        a = a * 0.5
    return t / (0.135 * sqrt(n))

cr = @cr
# stained softwood, one tone per plank; darker latewood lines, pores, knots
wood = lerp(set(0.44, 0.29, 0.17), set(0.58, 0.40, 0.25), cr)
wood = wood * (1 - 0.30 * @late) * (1 - 0.12 * @pores) * (1 + 0.05 * fbm(8, 2, 1.1 + cr * 50, 3))
wood = lerp(wood, set(0.24, 0.14, 0.08), @knot * 0.85)
# weathering: sun-greyed patches, darker grime in the joints
wood = lerp(wood, set(0.52, 0.49, 0.44), 0.35 * smoothstep(0.3, 1.8, fbm(3, 2, 7.4, 3)))
wood = lerp(set(0.10, 0.07, 0.05), wood, @plank)
# nails: dark steel heads, a rust halo, and a rust run below each nail
nu = (@pu - 0.5) / 8
nvb = where(abs(frac(@v) - 0.15) < abs(frac(@v) - 0.65), frac(@v) - 0.15, frac(@v) - 0.65)
run = (1 - smoothstep(0.002, 0.005, abs(nu))) * smoothstep(-0.07, -0.004, nvb) * where(nvb < 0, 1.0, 0.0)
halo = 1 - smoothstep(0.005, 0.011, @dn)
rust = clamp(halo * 0.7 + run * 0.45 * (0.6 + 0.4 * fbm(16, 64, 9.3, 2)), 0, 1)
c = lerp(wood, set(0.38, 0.19, 0.08), rust)
c = lerp(c, set(0.22, 0.22, 0.23), @nail)
c = c * lerp(0.75, 1.0, @ao_h)
@ao = @ao_h
@roughness = clamp(lerp(0.95, 0.72 - 0.06 * @late, @plank) + 0.15 * rust, 0, 1) * (1 - @nail) + 0.45 * @nail
@metallic = @nail * 0.9
# the colours above are picked as display (sRGB) values; the layer is linear -- Write File encodes it to sRGB
@basecolor = clamp(c, 0, 1) ** 2.2
nodes.title: M_Door: wooden planks -- colour / ORM

widgets_values:
# fbm(fx, fy, s, o): seamless fractal noise with fx × fy cells per metre (integers; unequal = stretched), seed s,
# o octaves; normalized to roughly unit variance (about -2.5..2.5), so thresholds read the same at any octave count
def fbm(fx, fy, s, o=4):
    t = 0
    a = 1.0
    n = 0
    for i in range(o):
        t = t + a * (pnoise(set(@u * fx, @v * fy, s + i * 7.13), set(fx, fy, 0)) - 0.5)
        n = n + a * a
        fx = fx * 2
        fy = fy * 2
        a = a * 0.5
    return t / (0.135 * sqrt(n))

S = 2
# seams at u = 0.25 / 0.75, so the tile border falls mid-pan (x = 0 / 1 is the seam centre)
x = frac(@u * S + 0.5)
dx = min(x, 1 - x) / S
# standing seam: 25 mm tall, 20 mm wide, rounded cap; two shallow stiffening ribs in each pan; oil-canning waviness
@seam = 1 - smoothstep(0.008, 0.011, dx)
cap = sqrt(clamp(1 - (dx / 0.011) ** 2, 0, 1))
dr = min(abs(x - 1 / 3), abs(x - 2 / 3)) / S
rib = 0.0015 * (1 - smoothstep(0.002, 0.007, dr))
oil = 0.0008 * fbm(2, 3, 1.1, 3) * smoothstep(0.02, 0.08, dx)
@height = 0.025 * cap ** 0.35 * @seam + rib + oil + 0.00003 * fbm(256, 256, 4.4, 2)
nodes.title: M_Roof: height (metres) + masks

widgets_values:
# fbm(fx, fy, s, o): seamless fractal noise with fx × fy cells per metre (integers; unequal = stretched), seed s,
# o octaves; normalized to roughly unit variance (about -2.5..2.5), so thresholds read the same at any octave count
def fbm(fx, fy, s, o=4):
    t = 0
    a = 1.0
    n = 0
    for i in range(o):
        t = t + a * (pnoise(set(@u * fx, @v * fy, s + i * 7.13), set(fx, fy, 0)) - 0.5)
        n = n + a * a
        fx = fx * 2
        fy = fy * 2
        a = a * 0.5
    return t / (0.135 * sqrt(n))

# chips: sharp-edged flakes, far more likely on the seam caps; a pale primer rim round each
chn = fbm(24, 24, 7.7, 4) + 1.4 * @seam + 0.5 * fbm(4, 4, 3.0, 2)
chip = smoothstep(1.85, 1.95, chn)
rim = smoothstep(1.6, 1.85, chn) * (1 - chip)
# paint: dark slate green, chalky sun-fading in big patches, dirt streaks running down the fall line
paint = set(0.24, 0.33, 0.31) * (1 + 0.04 * fbm(32, 32, 2.2, 3))
paint = lerp(paint, set(0.44, 0.49, 0.47), 0.45 * smoothstep(-0.5, 1.8, fbm(2, 3, 5.1, 3)))
st = smoothstep(0.2, 1.8, fbm(64, 2, 5.5, 3))
paint = paint * (1 - 0.16 * st)
metal = set(0.62, 0.63, 0.64) * (1 + 0.05 * fbm(48, 48, 6.3, 2))
c = lerp(lerp(paint, set(0.58, 0.58, 0.55), rim), metal, chip)
# rust: on part of the bare metal, plus thin rust runs in the streak lines of rustier regions
rr = smoothstep(0.0, 1.2, fbm(40, 40, 3.3, 3))
runs = smoothstep(1.1, 2.0, fbm(48, 3, 9.9, 3)) * smoothstep(0.3, 1.5, fbm(3, 3, 2.2, 2))
rust = clamp(chip * rr + 0.6 * runs * (1 - chip), 0, 1)
c = lerp(c, lerp(set(0.36, 0.17, 0.07), set(0.52, 0.28, 0.12), smoothstep(-1, 1, fbm(96, 96, 1.4, 2))), rust)
c = c * lerp(0.8, 1.0, @ao_h)
@ao = @ao_h
@metallic = chip * (1 - rust)
@roughness = clamp(lerp(0.52 + 0.15 * st, 0.32, chip) + 0.5 * rust, 0, 1)
# the colours above are picked as display (sRGB) values; the layer is linear -- Write File encodes it to sRGB
@basecolor = clamp(c, 0, 1) ** 2.2
nodes.title: M_Roof: standing-seam roof -- colour / ORM

# fbm(fx, fy, s, o): seamless fractal noise with fx × fy cells per metre (integers; unequal = stretched), seed s,
# o octaves; normalized to roughly unit variance (about -2.5..2.5), so thresholds read the same at any octave count
def fbm(fx, fy, s, o=4):
    t = 0
    a = 1.0
    n = 0
    for i in range(o):
        t = t + a * (pnoise(set(@u * fx, @v * fy, s + i * 7.13), set(fx, fy, 0)) - 0.5)
        n = n + a * a
        fx = fx * 2
        fy = fy * 2
        a = a * 0.5
    return t / (0.135 * sqrt(n))

# scratches: thin lines along a few directions. Directions use integer (a, b), so the rotated coordinates stay
# periodic over the 1 m tile; each line is cut into short pieces by noise along it
sc = 0
for k, (a, b, K) in enumerate(((1, 0, 23), (0, 1, 17), (1, 1, 19), (1, -1, 29), (2, 1, 13), (1, -2, 11))):
    along = a * @u + b * @v
    across = -b * @u + a * @v
    q = across * K + 0.2 * (pnoise(set(along * 8, across * K, k * 3.1), set(8, K, 0)) - 0.5)
    line = 1 - smoothstep(0.0, 0.0004 * K * sqrt(a * a + b * b), abs(frac(q) - 0.5))
    seg = smoothstep(0.62, 0.70, pnoise(set(along * 24, across * K, k * 5.7 + 2), set(24, K, 0)))
    sc = max(sc, line * seg)

@height = 0.00004 * fbm(220, 220, 3.3, 2) - 0.00008 * sc
